blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Declaring that “innocent blood has no religion,” two prominent Moro leaders in Mindanao are demanding universal accountability and an immediate end to the escalating military aggression across the Middle East. Invoking a Quranic verse on human dignity, Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) acting chairman Shaykh Abdulkarim Tan Misuari called attention to the sanctity of human life, reminding the global community that compassion and justice must remain universal. Misuari pointed out that the lives of Muslims and non-Muslims are equally precious and should never be subjected to double standards. READ: Amid Middle East war, senators tell cabinet […]...
